subject: LaunchBoost onboarding grant + sandbox credits — qualification & invoicing
messages:
From: Kate Reynolds <kate@launchboost.co>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: CFO <finance@launchboost.co>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick Q: combining onboarding grant with sandbox credits

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looks promising for our ingestion use case. Two quick questions from the LaunchBoost side as we map internal budgets:

1) We were given a 50k onboarding grant for the accelerator cohort (paperwork attached). Can that be combined with the 30k sandbox credits you provide to early-stage companies, or are those mutually exclusive?

2) We expect a potential burst in month 3 that would exceed the onboarding grant. Is there a standard top-up path (paid add-on vs one-time exception) you typically approve for cohorts? If there’s a formal process to request a temporary top-up, can you share the steps and likely timelines — our CFO is copied.

We’d like to finalize the cost plan before we onboard the first 10 teams.

Best,
Kate Reynolds
Program Director | LaunchBoost
kate@launchboost.co
Attachment: launchboost_onboarding_notice.pdf (pdf stub)

-----

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Kate Reynolds <kate@launchboost.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick Q: combining onboarding grant with sandbox credits

Hi Kate — great to meet you yesterday, and thanks for the clear questions. Short answers to start, then a proposed next step:

- Stacking: We can stack the accelerator onboarding grant with the sandbox credits in most cohort cases; the main limitation is accounting — credits stack on consumption but cannot be used to offset committed Dedicated purchases.
- Top-up: For month-to-month bursts we usually offer either (a) a paid top-up with net30 invoice or (b) a short-term promotional top-up approved by our Partnerships team (rare, approved for high-impact cohorts). Approval timelines for promotional top-ups are typically 3–7 business days.

Proposed next step: I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) with two optional paths: standard paid top-up or a provisional 30% promotional top-up for one month (requires approvals below). If you’re comfortable, sign the MAP and we’ll route the promotional top-up for a rapid review.

Attachments: LB_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf, pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx

I’ll loop Ben for pricing confirmation and Lauren for partner approvals.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: combining onboarding grant with sandbox credits

Kate — thanks for the context. A couple points on the pricing side to make the path to sign fast: 

- If LaunchBoost confirms purely cohort/accelerator usage (no Dedicated reservations), we can approve stacking the 50k onboarding grant with the 30k sandbox credits. They will apply in consumption order (sandbox first, then onboarding).
- For the burst: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx shows two pay-as-you-go top-up options (standard rate and a cohort-discounted rate for partners). For a promotional one-month top-up at a discounted rate we’ll need a short approval from Partnerships (Lauren) + Finance sign-off.

If LaunchBoost is OK with a provisional approach, I can originate an internal pricing approval ticket today and tag Finance for a 48–72 hour review. Kate — could you confirm which SLAs (latency/regions) are required? That’ll affect the cost delta.

Best,
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx

Thanks Ben — we’ll take stacking with sandbox-first consumption. SLA: <200ms P95 for 512-token median requests in us-west. No dedicated reservation for month 1–3; dedicated might be evaluated if team growth > 20% MoM.

If you can send the provisional pricing approval language I can run it by our CFO for sign-off. Also happy to sign the MAP to expedite.

Kate

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Hi all — I reviewed the MAP and pricing matrix. Approve the following provisional path: 

1) Stack onboarding grant + sandbox credits (consumption order: sandbox then onboarding).
2) Approve a one-time promotional top-up equal to 30% of the onboarding grant (15k) for a single month at a cohort-discounted rate. Conditions: LaunchBoost signs the MAP and accepts the Redwood terms addendum.
3) Redwood Finance will invoice LaunchBoost for any paid top-ups (net30). Promotional top-up will be issued as a credit note and applied to the account once paperwork is complete.

Legal/procurement note: redwood_terms_addendum.pdf must be executed — Kate, if your CFO is comfortable with DocuSign we can send the addendum and the MAP today and move to execution.

Ben — please open the pricing approval ticket to route Finance. Aditya — prep the DocuSign bundle and mark the MAP as required for the promotional credit.

Thanks,
